The '''Socorro system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which consisted of the [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] star [[Sokor/Legends|Sokor]], the [[Thrugii Asteroid Belt]], and the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] and [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Socorro System is mistakenly referred to as the "Socorran sector" on page 119 of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 2]].
